declared: 2026-10-30, after live_001 (E1_TEST_C_s1602 SCENE_INFEASIBLE, refused before launch) and live_002 (E1_TEST_C_s1602 NOT_RUN, runtime error at step 691) and before any live_003 run. Supplementary stage for E1_TEST_C_s1602 only. Every rule of generalization_round1_live.json is inherited unchanged: task builder and live recompile (same scene, same goal JSON, same duration rule), controller (goal_planner_v1, path_v2, plane_section, planner overrides 1 deg / 1 mm per step, measured edge feedback, per-sample rake/skew/direction from the round goal), schedule, runtime (seed 42, Native Isaac Sim 6.2, cameras, record_every 5 for this sample), goal evaluator (goals.evaluate_goal), success criteria, outcome classes and precedence, home_outcome and failure policy. Only the code commit and the launch preflight wording (below) differ. The live_001 result of this sample stays SCENE_INFEASIBLE and the live_002 result stays NOT_RUN; both records are unchanged and reported as such. live_003 is a separate, labelled result; no threshold is changed and nothing is rescored.
reason: Both earlier failures were infrastructure, not properties of the scene or of the cut. (1) live_001: the runner's default C2 plan preflight modelled all three protrusions as one convex hull for the whole plan and refused the plan (blade vs bump -8.4 mm at PRE_CUT:p2, contact_free); the round file's staged multi-protrusion geometry passes the same live task (blade_collision slack +0.05 mm, same thresholds). (2) live_002: with the staged preflight the episode ran 691 control steps (SKIM:p0, WITHDRAW:p0, SKIM:p1 done; SKIM:p2 armed; grasp HOLDING, IK ok) and then aborted in the presentation surface update: cutting_surface.extract raised RuntimeError('ParticleSurface returned no mesh for 11 physical particles') for an 11-particle fragment. That mesh is the visual/render surface only (not the material solver, not the evaluator). Fixes, committed before this declaration: cutting_surface.CuttingSurface.extract omits current mechanical components that ParticleSurface cannot mesh from the presentation mesh only and records them in the surface diagnostics (unmeshable_skipped: fragments, particles, components); physics, cut labels, goal evaluation and recording are unchanged and all-meshable outputs are byte-identical (tests/test_cutting_surface.py). The runner's default plan preflight (scripts/wp11_motion_preflight.py plan) now uses the round-1 staged geometry (generalization.staged_preflight) for scenes with two or more protrusions; zero/one-protrusion tasks keep exactly the previous check (tests/test_wp11_default_preflight_staged.py).

code.text: A fresh detached git worktree at the commit that adds this file (git_dirty = False), runtime directories linked as in live_001/002. Its parents contain the surface fix (d3f94e9) and the default-preflight change (2b4f0a7; also the report-only staged measured-path check and the opt-in render palette). Analysis and rendering may use a later clean worktree; the run itself uses this commit.

preflight.text: The Native runner's own default plan preflight (scripts/run_wp10_live.py plan_preflight -> scripts/wp11_motion_preflight.py plan, CPU .venv, before any Isaac launch) is used, NOT --skip-plan-preflight. For this three-protrusion scene it applies generalization.staged_preflight (round file stages.stage1_geometry: the same dense IK chain from q_home over the full live plan HOME -> ... -> RETURN_HOME, checked in contiguous chunks against the declared workpiece without the protrusions removed by earlier remove operations; remaining protrusions keep the C2 hull; same C2 thresholds; joint continuity over the whole chain); receipt run_001/plan_preflight.json with preflight_geometry.rule = staged_multi_protrusion_v1. It must PASS; a FAIL is a refusal before launch (SCENE_INFEASIBLE / IK_FAILURE) and nothing runs.

device_policy_note: Inherited device policy unchanged (a GPU with <= 2 other active jobs and >= 12 GiB free, never stopping non-RCS processes, /mnt/data floor 15 GB). This stage has a single sample and the queue relaunches only after an attempt has ended, so at most one Isaac job of this stage exists at any time (the inherited max_mine = 2 is never reached).
failure_policy_note: Inherited: a live episode that fails after its first recorded control step is kept and classified and is not retried. Only a crash before the first recorded control step (infrastructure, not a preflight refusal) is relaunched once into run_002.

samples.purpose: Test C: three protrusions removed one at a time, tlmpm_v5 (kinematic all >= 0.946); live_003 after the surface fix, with the staged default preflight

reporting_additions: chip independence (each removed protrusion a separate mechanical component, not merged with the substrate or with another chip)
tau/psi/rho/mu of the measured edge for each skim
measured-path C2 clearance check: declared uncut geometry (as live_001) and, report only, the staged geometry (measured_task_path_clearance_staged)
surface diagnostics: unmeshable_skipped fragments/particles if any (presentation only)
wall time, device, git sha, disk use
